{"summary":"Read-only review of the 4 supplied files only. Result: 0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, 1 MINOR, 4 NIT. Both fixes check out in the source. Fix1: the queued label in page.tsx now reads 'not yet issued (request recorded only)', and the queued test checks for that label and checks that the old 'pending' word is absent. Fix2: the populated, empty and queued page tests each check for the exact sentence saying that payment, a saved invoice request or an export does not mean an invoice was issued. Each of those tests also checks that the old 'export issuance report CSV' label and the old 'auto-scheduled after payment' wording are gone. On product safety, the supplied files no longer say or imply that an invoice is issued automatically. The page notice and empty state say auto-issuance is unavailable. Queued rows show no invoice number and no issue date. The checkout fieldset is titled 'invoice request' and shows a static unavailable notice. Field names, validation, maxLength/pattern/required constraints and the invoiceFieldError logic are the same as the original. The finance guard is still applied before the query, the query is still limited to the vendor, and a test covers the denied-access case. Retained as before: one MINOR (no interactive test for type/carrier switching or the onInput validation path) and NITs for option-label and live-region polish. Two new NITs are about test precision only. These files make no legal, provider-activation or tax-exemption claim. The export route body was not supplied, so the CSV header and status text were not checked; nothing here claims it was. The original WP04 dependency is still open, and the WP as a whole is not complete. The test pass count (60) and the claim that checkout files are byte-identical to the prior review are reported, not verified here.","findings":[{"severity":"MINOR","file":"src/components/checkout-invoice-fields.test.tsx","area":"Test coverage - interactive states (retained)","issue":"No test drives the client-side switching (personal/company/donation, carrier member/mobile/citizen_certificate) or the onInput -> invoiceValueFromForm -> setError path. The tests only cover the default static render, the disabled render, and invoiceFieldError called directly.","evidence":"The tests use renderToStaticMarkup only, so they see the default state (personal + member). invoiceValueFromForm is not exported and is never exercised. There is no check that the unavailable notice stays visible after the type or carrier changes, or that the alert text is filled on invalid input.","impact":"A regression in the conditional fields, in the FormData mapping, or in the notice's position relative to the switched fields would not be caught. The risk is low because the notice is rendered outside the conditional branches.","recommended_fix":"Retained per human decision (no framework expansion). If interaction tests are allowed later, add a jsdom/testing-library test that switches type and carrier, types invalid values, and checks the alert text and that the notice is still present.","required_test":"Interactive test: select company, enter an invalid business ID, and check the business ID error. Select donation and check the donation-code error. Select personal + mobile, enter a lowercase barcode, and check the mobile error.
